paragraphs: The artdaq toolkit is a data-acquisition framework designed for high-energy physics experiments. It provides a flexible, reliable backbone for data transfers and has several locations where users can perform custom analysis tasks using the art framework.
The artdaq suite consists of the following packages:

This package contains Destination plugins for the MessageFacility, a Qt-based MessageViewer application, and a Qt-based MessageAnalyzer application. MessageViewer allows the user to receive MessageFacility messages over UDP and display and filter them (code originally used the rms layer and was part of NOvADAQ). MessageAnalyzer allows for rules to run on received messages and command-line scripts to be executed in response (also adapted from NOvADAQ).
features: artdaq-core: Data formats used by the artdaq toolkit
artdaq-utilities: Online tools, primarily metrics reporting
artdaq-mfextensions: Extensions to the MessageFacility product which are useful in DAQ context
artdaq: Application and data transfer framework
